Correct the CAST and layout to match reference 2 (the other style's title composition): exactly TWO characters, Xiaocui at the far LEFT foreground preparing an underhand volleyball receive and Aming at the far RIGHT foreground jumping to spike the ball overhead. No typography, signatures or watermarks.
